The Ambassador Grand Bed is an upholstered bed frame with a large, deeply padded headboard and ambassador-style panel detailing, handmade to order in Dewsbury on a wooden slatted base.

Key features

  • Grand ambassador-style panel headboard
  • Deeply padded upholstered headboard
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £402.99; Small Double (4FT) £441.99; Double (4FT6) £461.99; King (5FT) £493.99; Super King (6FT) £558.99. Not sure which size to pick? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes; custom fabric and colour options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. You can return it free within 14 days if unused and unassembled in its original packaging (we collect it), and if an item arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What sizes does the Ambassador Grand Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Can I choose a different colour or fabric?

Yes. Solid colours, stripes and two-tone finishes are available in Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, and custom fabric and colour requests are welcome.

Where is the Ambassador Grand Bed made?

It is handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden frame.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check the colour and texture at home before ordering.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What warranty does it have?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty.

Browse all upholstered beds or read how to choose an upholstered bed. Also see the Line Ambassador Bed.

Key features

  • Fan-shaped radiating panel headboard

p2.descriptionHtml:
Soft folds of velvet give the Aria Pleated Velvet Bed a relaxed, tailored elegance. The headboard is gathered into deep vertical pleats by hand, catching the light so the colour shifts as you move around the room.

Key features

  • Hand-pleated velvet headboard with deep, soft folds
  • Fully upholstered base that sits neatly to the floor
  • Plush velvet in your choice of colour
  • Handmade to order in our West Yorkshire workshop
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Materials and build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop, with no exposed legs. Free fabric swatches are available so you can see the colour in your own light before you order.

Sizes available

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Standard Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Need a different size or headboard height? Ask us about a bespoke version.

Mattress compatibility

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our pocket sprung, memory foam and pillow top mattresses to complete the bed.

Delivery

Free delivery to addresses across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Let us know about stairs or tight access when you order.

Care

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot any spills straight away with a clean, damp cloth.

Backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.
